Falsifiers this model must survive (implemented in R0.4.2)
Partition alone: B cannot attach solely because A is unreachable.
Stale loss evidence cannot close a newer generation.
Two finalizations of the same generation: second is rejected in replay.
Replacement grants zero Worker authority by itself.
Revoked authority stays revoked through replacement.
Recovery cannot mint a new generation.
Orderly detach still works, unchanged, including mixed logs.
